value.rationale: At one fixed time the fourth cumulant alone confounds diffusivity contrast with switching speed. The exact eighth/fourth invariant eliminates this ambiguity through a nontrivial sharp global sign theorem and produces the full physically admissible measured-triple region. The result is a complete natural inverse classification of an experimentally motivated two-state fluctuating diffusivity, not merely a sample polynomial evaluation.
